summary: Build API product briefs, platform roadmaps, and KPI scorecards in 5 days. Learn practical methods for ecosystem growth and governance.
lede: API economy and platform business models connect API products with revenue, partner participation, and platform governance. For product, technology, architecture, transformation, and business development professionals, the course covers assessing API portfolios, shaping monetization choices and partner onboarding, and setting governance controls and performance measures. Participants practice defining API product offers, mapping partner journeys, and creating maturity and KPI scorecards.
audienceIntro: This API economy and platform business models training is built for professionals who need to connect product, technology, and commercial decisions around API-led growth.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: a working understanding of digital products, enterprise technology delivery, or commercial operations in platform-enabled businesses. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading product briefs, business cases, and basic API terminology such as endpoints, authentication, and lifecycle stages. If you support API governance or platform strategy, bring any existing API catalog, partnership funnel, or product scorecard you use today; these artifacts will help you adapt the workshop outputs to your environment.
